name: Daniel O'Connell
bio:
Daniel O'Connell's path to motorsport finance was unconventional. Starting as a CPA for a regional accounting firm, he quickly gained a reputation for his meticulousness and strategic financial planning. A chance encounter with a racing team owner at a charity event sparked his interest in the high-stakes world of motorsport. He made the leap, initially taking a pay cut to learn the ropes, but quickly proved his value. 

Daniel's approach to financial control is proactive, not reactive. He believes in building robust forecasting models and identifying potential risks before they materialize. His calm demeanor under pressure and his ability to communicate complex financial data in an understandable way make him a valuable asset to any team. He is known for his ability to find efficiencies and maximize return on investment, even in the face of tight budgets.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight recession at the temples.
physical.description: A man of average height with a focused gaze and a slightly weary smile.

quirks: Starts every budget meeting with a finance-related joke.
Obsessively organizes his desk by color.
